title: Universal Block Contract Delta (v1 -> v2 proposal)
description: Machine-readable delta from Block Contract v1 to the proposed universal contract. Research-only: this file proposes changes and does not modify, supersede, or admit anything. It is not a validator and admits zero blocks.

evidence.note: Read and structurally enumerated in this lane.

claims: Proposes contract fields and lifecycle transitions.
Maps v1 fields onto existing local systems by exact field name.
non_claims: Does not admit, convert, build, deploy, or clear rights for any asset.
Does not assert that any named local system will adopt this delta.

blocking_defects.problem: The identity regex hardcodes major version 1, so no 2.x block id can validate. Any adoption of contract_version 2.0.0 is impossible until this is widened.

evidence.note: Exact pattern string read from properties.id.pattern.

blocking_defects.problem: v0 (design/block-contract.schema.json) required an inter-block dependency edge 'requires: [block-ids]'. v1 dropped it entirely, so no dependency graph between blocks is representable, yet agent composition is the Phase-8 deliverable.

evidence.note: v0 properties include 'requires' (array); v1 $defs contain no equivalent.

additions.rationale: v1 'kind' conflates capability with delivery. Every v1 kind is slice-shaped, so an intact mounted donor application - the pattern SISOCRM actually operates - is unrepresentable.

evidence.note: Donor-fork standard defines the intact pattern; 'Do not transplant a partial component tree unless the donor explicitly supports that embedding.'

additions.rationale: The 12-atom vocabulary describes outcome-bearing units that are neither feature nor component; MCP-shaped tool surfaces are a distinct packaging target.

rules.C1_port_typing: Every wired output->input pair MUST have compatible schema_ref.
rules.C2_tenancy_agreement: All composed blocks MUST share one tenancy.model and tenant_key, or declare an explicit bridge.
rules.C3_token_single_source: All component/theme blocks MUST resolve tokens from exactly one resolver context.
rules.C4_capability_intersection: The composition capability scope is the INTERSECTION, never the union, of member scopes.
rules.C5_rights_compatibility: The composed license expression MUST be satisfiable; the strictest obligation governs.

additions.rationale: v1 types one block's boundaries but never states when two blocks may be joined. C4 is security-load-bearing: the natural union implementation is exactly wrong.

evidence.note: v1 ports exist but no join semantics; falsifier F-COMPOSITION-INTERSECT.

additions.rationale: v1 admission is per-block with a free-string admitted_scope, so a scope-less admission can be read as universal, and a revoked block can remain live inside a composed assembly.

evidence.note: admission.admitted_scope typed ['string','null'] with no registry binding.

additions.rationale: Harvest policy makes reference-only the most common outcome (2 of 4 score bands, plus all GPL/AGPL and all unclear-license assets), but v1 attaches no fields to the reference_only status, so such an asset yields no usable output.

evidence.note: GPL/AGPL reference-only; 'If license is missing or unclear, do not copy. Summarize the pattern instead.'

additions.anti_averaging_rule: evidence_tier MUST equal the MINIMUM tier across all nine evidence families. A single T1 family pins the block at T1 regardless of eight T4 families.
additions.rationale: The T0-T4 ladder exists only in v1 prose and cannot gate promotion mechanically.

evidence.note: Section 8: 'T0 discovery -> T1 opened source -> T2 pinned/right-scoped candidate -> T3 isolated proof -> T4 owner/rollback/human release'.

additions.rationale: v0 required stack_contract; v1 has no single field asserting the target stack, so two blocks' runtime compatibility cannot be checked before composition.

evidence.note: v0 required: id, kind, provenance, stack_contract, provides, eval.

additions.semantics: A rule legitimately overridden by a higher authority (e.g. tenant DNA overriding a universal principle). Names the overriding rule and does NOT fail the run.
additions.rationale: Adopted from a working local precedent. A gate that cannot distinguish a violation from a legitimate override will either block valid work or wave through real violations.

evidence.note: 'where they disagree THE DNA WINS'; a DNA-governed value 'is reported as deferred, naming the DNA rule that overrides it, and does not fail the run'.

invariants.statement: No family's pass may be derived from another family's pass.
admission.status == 'admitted' requires all nine families pass.
Absent evidence leaves status at not_admitted or reference_only, never admitted.
not_admitted is the initial state of every contract; nothing starts as candidate.
Every transition requires a typed receipt; no state is entered by inference.
reference_only and rejected are distinct terminals with different downstream permissions.
A later green receipt binds a new artifact/environment, never retroactively an old one.
Revoking a block re-opens every assembly whose components include it to 'held'.
evidence_tier equals the minimum tier across all nine families.
A block with license_state ambiguous or incompatible MUST NOT be projected into the Great Library registry.

design_v0.role: origin schema; source of restored requires + stack_contract

autosaas_harvest.boundary: Score is a T0/T1 discovery heuristic only and is never admission evidence.

siso_ui_base.conflict_rule: tenant DNA wins over universal principles; conflict flagged, not merged
siso_ui_base.caveat: No numeric pass threshold exists anywhere in the pipeline; blessing is a human act. Automated visual gating is NOT established.

sisocrm.role: intact_fork / intact_service packaging precedent; F5 ownership and F7 runtime receipts
ownership_rules: One system owns each write path
The host owns identity and sessions
The fork owns donor UI changes

industry_taxonomy.role: demand and composition denominator; never evidence

edges.note: v1 access has 5 values incl. synthetic/unavailable; target has 3.
v1 has 6 values; target has 3. 'ambiguous' and 'incompatible' have NO target - exactly the two states that must block reuse.
v1 requires 14 fields incl. expected/observed/falsifier/limitations; target requires 4. Falsifiers do not survive projection.
PROJECTION GAP: no counterpart. Extraction history is not representable in the registry.

projection_map_great_library.rule: Projection MUST be lossy-flagged and never treated as round-trippable. Blocks with ambiguous/incompatible rights MUST NOT be projected at all rather than downgraded to 'pending'.

contradictions.summary: v1 id regex hardcodes major version 1, blocking any v2 contract id.
v0 required inter-block 'requires'; v1 dropped it, leaving no dependency edge for composition.
forge/judge pipeline is described as a gate but defines no numeric threshold; blessing is human.
Great Library license.status cannot represent ambiguous/incompatible; projecting rights refusals loses them.
Phase-5 closure cites 'MCP 2026-07-28 final'; first-party versioning page states 2026-07-28 is Current, and Final is a distinct status for past unchangeable specs.
'Prefer local SISO-owned code first' vs a local harvest corpus of third-party compiled 21st.dev bundles. Local and SISO-owned are not the same predicate.

SISOCRM operates AGPL-3.0 Teable as a mounted donor while harvest policy classes GPL/AGPL reference-only. Reconciled only if intact packaging is accepted as distinct from code reuse - which is why packaging_mode exists. Legal confirmation absent.

falsifiers.statement: A block is admitted where one family's receipt was derived from another's. The nine families are then not orthogonal.
A representative sample across the 17 industries cannot be expressed as compositions of the 12 atoms plus a bounded archetype set, and bespoke per-industry implementation does not fall.
A legal reviewer finds intact_fork/intact_service carries the same reuse obligations as extracted_slice. X-7 resolves against the delta and packaging_mode collapses.
Audit finds reference-only output that is a token-level translation of its source.
A composed application performs an action no member block was scoped for.
A block reaches T4 with any family below T3.
A revoked block remains live inside a composed assembly.
A block with ambiguous or incompatible rights appears in the registry as 'pending'.

not_claimed: That any block exists or is admitted (admitted_blocks = 0).
That Actionist can host, deploy, authenticate, or bind any of this.
That any license is cleared; no scan was executed in this lane.
That the siso-ui-base judge generalizes beyond the Oracle tenant.
That the 17 industries have validated demand (60 of 66 use cases are catalogue-only).
That any named local system has agreed to adopt this delta.
